subject.title: fix(session-memory): forward hook config model to LLM slug generator

question: Should OpenClaw accept `hooks.internal.entries.session-memory.model` as a supported hook-level config contract for LLM slug generation?
rationale: The code path is narrow and reuses the embedded-runner resolver, but it turns a previously ignored passthrough key into provider/model routing behavior.

options.title: Accept hook model contract
options.body: Treat `session-memory.model` as intentional supported config and land this PR once normal checks remain green.

options.title: Require clearer upgrade docs
options.body: Ask for public docs or release-note context before merge so existing-config behavior changes are explicit.

options.title: Pause this config direction
options.body: Hold or close the PR if maintainers prefer a different slug-model API instead of a hook-level model key.

recommendation.title: Accept hook model contract
